hooks.name: Autopsy on spec save
hooks.description: Re-run the autopsy when a requirements file is saved and list new ghosts. Logs to .autopsy/hook.log

action.command: mkdir -p .autopsy; L=.autopsy/hook.log; printf '%s fired %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$(head -c 200 | tr '\r\n' '  ')" >> "$L"; npm run --silent autopsy >> "$L" 2>&1; c=$?; echo "exit=$c" >> "$L"; exit $c
